project_tracker_diagnostic: Annual with leaves dissected into very narrow threadlike segments; heads usually have 8 yellow rays and red-brown to yellow discs; common in disturbed limestone and roadside settings.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common, conspicuous, or high-value comparison species for Central Texas field ID.

morphology_keys.leaves: Cauline leaves divided into narrow linear to filiform lobes.
morphology_keys.heads: Usually 8 yellow to golden-yellow rays; disc corollas red-brown or yellow with red-brown nerves.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Involucre subtended by a calyculus of 7–8+ narrow bractlets.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
